title: Your first trade for Tuesday, Oct 30
text:

Tim Seymour was a buyer of Lowe's
Karen Finerman was a buyer of Macy's
Steve Grasso was a buyer of the Utilties ETF
Guy Adami was a buyer of Eli Lilly
